notes: Stories created for BRAND-001 covering schema, logic, API/UI, tests, and integration.

stories.title: Define Brand Audit Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a schema for brand audit results including artifact source, detected name variants, compliance status, and recommended correction to enforce 'ChatHealthy.ai' naming consistency.

stories.title: Implement Brand Name Detection and Audit Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to scan artifacts (code, UI strings, documents) and detect deviations from the required 'ChatHealthy.ai' naming standard, including partial matches like 'ChatHealthy'.

stories.title: Expose Brand Audit Results via API and Admin UI
stories.description: Provide an API endpoint and lightweight UI/report output to display audit findings, including non-compliant artifacts and suggested fixes for naming consistency.

stories.title: Brand Audit Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Create tests validating detection accuracy, false positive handling, and end-to-end audit flow across representative artifacts (frontend, backend, documents).

stories.title: Integrate Brand Audit into Dev Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate brand audit execution into the dev pipeline (e.g., manifest generation or CI step) to ensure naming compliance is automatically checked before promotion.
